case_name: Guddu Kumar & Ors vs State & Anr
facts_of_case: Petitioners filed a petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashing of FIR No.103/2016 and the proceedings emanating therefrom. Parties settled their disputes through mediation on 19.8.2019, with petitioner agreeing to pay Rs.4,50,000/- to respondent.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle their disputes through mediation and mutual consent.
legal_principles.held: The parties have settled their disputes on their own free will, without any force or coercion before the Mediation Centre, Saket Courts, Delhi.

legal_principles.principle: A settlement between parties can be a valid basis for quashing criminal proceedings.
legal_principles.held: The petitioners have brought a demand draft bearing No.055844, dated 7.1.2020, drawn on State Bank of India, for an amount of Rs.1,50,000/-, which has been handed over to the respondent.

outcome.final_order: FIR No.103/2016 and the proceedings emanating therefrom were quashed in the interest of justice.

use_for_drafting: quashing FIRs in domestic violence cases
